title: The Unintended Consequence of Land Finance: Evidence from Corporate Tax Avoidance
authors: Tao Chen; Youchao Tan; Jinghua Wang; Cheng Colin Zeng
eligible_reason: Tax-avoidance slope design (Cai-Liu): reported profit RPRO regressed on imputed profit PRO and PRO x land-revenue-loss, where the land-loss regressor is continuous (LAND_loss) or an above-mean indicator that turns on and off by city-year (D_LAND_loss). Quasi-experiments in Tables 3-4 are single-date shocks (2006 North Korean nuclear test, 2011 Fukushima) entering as triple interactions with PRO. Only city FE (no firm FE), time-varying firm controls in all columns. Firm data not shipped.
design_notes: Program_Main.do: areg RPRO PRO LAND_loss PRO_LAND_loss $Control i.industry i.year, abs(City) cluster(City); Tables 3-4 add PROTreat_NPost_N (nuclear-proximity treatment x post x PRO). NBS industrial-firm survey 1999-2012.
estimators_reported: pooled OLS with city, industry, year FE (slope-interaction design)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Continuous city-year treatment; quasi-experiments have one date each.
excluded_specs_summary: Tables 2, 5-8: continuous LAND_loss (or non-absorbing D_LAND_loss) x PRO with city FE and controls. Tables 3-4: single-date shocks x PRO triple interactions with controls.
data_provenance_note: README: NBS firm data cannot be distributed (confidentiality agreement); only city-level auxiliary files shipped.
